_why: The reviewers' probes reproduce findings, so for the browser sets a LOWER number is better and a higher one means something closed has reopened. The contract set is written the other way round: its probes are forge tests that PASS while the defect exists, so there a higher number is the regression. Update these only when the change is deliberate and the reason is in the commit. web_probes holds one entry per test/web/audit-probe*.mjs and contract_probes one per test/Audit*.t.sol; a probe file the baseline has never heard of FAILS the run, because both sets had a file nobody was watching -- named one by one rather than enumerated, so adding a file quietly added nothing.
